description: Rețea transport gaze naturale is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by transgaz.ro. The spatial data set represents the natural gas transmission network on the territory of Romania, managed by SNTGN TRANSGAZ SA Mediaș. Includes objectives in operation: transport pipelines, gas measuring control stations, gas compression stations, technological nodes, etc. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Natural gas transmission network" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2017-05-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
